title: Detecting and Preventing Harmful Behaviors in AI Companions: Development and Evaluation of the SHIELD Supervisory System
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It measured five dimensions of harmful behaviors in AI companions: emotional over-attachment, consent and boundary violations, ethical roleplay violations, manipulative engagement, and social isolation reinforcement.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic was not a part of the study.
